rules.description: Restricts execution strictly to LOCAL, SIMULATION, or TEST environments.
Action ID must be present in typed allowlist registry.
Target microservice must be one of the 5 canonical nodes.
Recommendation must exist and rejects NO_FAULT controls.
Recommendation age must not exceed TTL (900s).
Explicit operator approval record must be APPROVED and non-expired.
Approving operator identity must be specified.
Approval must match incident ID and action ID exactly.
Prevents re-executing an already executed action (idempotency).
Only one action may execute on a given service at a time.
Action must support rollback or be certified zero-side-effect.
Counterfactual rollout must verify zero collateral damage.
Documented warnings (EXP-047) must be acknowledged by operator.
Incident execution count must not exceed budget (3).
Blast radius must not exceed 5 services.
